description.en: The USB Micro-B receptacle interface: a five-contact opening 6.9 × 1.85 mm whose bottom corners are chamfered to 5.4 mm, so a Micro-B plug enters one way up only.
description.es: La interfaz del receptáculo USB Micro-B: una abertura de cinco contactos de 6.9 × 1.85 mm con las esquinas inferiores achaflanadas hasta 5.4 mm, de modo que una clavija Micro-B entra en una sola posición.
description.fr: L'interface de l'embase USB Micro-B : une ouverture à cinq contacts de 6,9 × 1,85 mm dont les coins inférieurs sont chanfreinés jusqu'à 5,4 mm, si bien qu'une fiche Micro-B n'entre que dans un sens.
description.pt: A interface do receptáculo USB Micro-B: uma abertura de cinco contatos de 6,9 × 1,85 mm com os cantos inferiores chanfrados até 5,4 mm, de modo que uma ficha Micro-B só entra num sentido.

governing.designation: USB Micro-USB Cables and Connectors Specification, Revision 1.01

sources.title: Universal Serial Bus Micro-USB Cables and Connectors Specification, Revision 1.01 (April 4, 2007)
sources.publisher: USB Implementers Forum (in the USB 2.0 specification package)
sources.supports: Figure 4-10 (Micro-B receptacle interface): opening 6.9 +0.06/−0.02 wide and 1.85 +0.08/−0.02 high, 5.4 ±0.05 wide at the bottom where the chamfers meet, 3.5 ±0.1 deep from the shell front to the back wall; tongue 2.7 +0.05/−0.08 long. Figure 4-7 (Micro-B plug): shell 6.85 +0.02/−0.06 wide and 1.8 +0.02/−0.08 high, 5.3 wide at the bottom; Figure 4-8: 5.4 min from the overmold face to the tip; Figure 4-5: overmold 10.6 max wide, 8.5 max high. §4.2: five contacts. §4.5.6: a wrong-way insertion is blocked

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the opening on the receptacle's front (mating) face. +z points out of the opening, toward a plug; +x runs along the opening's width; +y = z × x runs along its height, pointing from the chamfered (narrow) side of the opening toward its full-width side. The body behind the face lies at z < 0.

opening_bottom_width.note: where the chamfers meet the narrow side

depth.note: from the shell front to the back wall

plug_overmold_width_max.note: the opening an enclosure leaves must clear the plug's overmold

interfaces.note: Female: a Micro-B plug enters the opening. Symmetry 1: the chamfered outline admits it one way up only (§4.5.6).

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The Micro-USB specification ships inside the USB 2.0 package on the USB-IF document library; its licence allows internal reproduction only, so the entry states facts and copies no drawing. No panel cutout is given, so the body is not modelled.
